quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #15
										  					
  

18 Questions • Passing Score 15

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic signal means a ____ light will appear soon.

options.text: Flashing yellow
Steady green
Steady red
Flashing red

questions.explanation: A steady yellow light warns you that a steady red light is coming next.

questions.question: You are driving in the right lane and want to move to the left lane. You should:

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for traffic behind you.
Look over your left shoulder to check your blind spot.
Check your side mirror and turn on your signal.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and look over your shoulder to make sure no vehicles are in your way. Always signal before you change lanes.

questions.question: If you must drive in fog, you should:

options.text: Turn on your low beam headlights.
Turn on your hazard lights.
Drive at the maximum speed limit.
Never drive above 10 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect off fog and rain, making it harder to see. Use low beams when visibility is 500 feet or less.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When slow driving blocks the normal flow of traffic
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone
Only in rural areas
When driving in bad weather

questions.correctAnswerText: When slow driving blocks the normal flow of traffic
questions.explanation: Driving too slowly can be illegal if it blocks traffic flow. You can get a ticket for driving too slowly.

questions.question: You should drive below the posted speed limit when:

options.text: Driving conditions are not perfect
You see a police car
You are entering a highway with other cars
You are on a four-lane road

questions.explanation: When roads are wet or slippery, visibility is poor, or any condition is less than ideal, slow down below the speed limit. You can be ticketed for driving too fast for the conditions, even if you are within the speed limit.

questions.question: At night, what is hardest to see?

options.text: Road signs
Pedestrians
Other vehicles
Street lights

questions.explanation: Pedestrians are harder to see at night than signs and other roadside objects.

questions.question: An "End school zone" sign means:

options.text: The speed limit is 20 mph
A reduced speed zone is beginning
More pedestrians may be present
A reduced speed zone is ending

questions.correctAnswerText: A reduced speed zone is ending
questions.explanation: The "End school zone" sign marks where the reduced speed zone ends. Follow the posted speed limit during the times shown on the sign.

questions.question: What is the main concern with this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may go out of alignment if one side of your car is higher
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder
You could hydroplane if water is on the shoulder
You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This will cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: When you hear a fire engine siren behind you, you must:

options.text: Slow down until it passes
Turn on your flashers
Pull over to the side and stop
Speed up and take the nearest exit

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the side and stop
questions.explanation: When you hear an emergency vehicle siren, pull to the side of the road and stop.

questions.question: When two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The vehicle coming from the right
The vehicle coming from the left
The driver who honks first
The vehicle traveling fastest

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle coming from the right
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no traffic control device, yield to the vehicle approaching from your right.

questions.question: If another car is about to hit you, what should you do?

options.text: Sound your horn.
Wave your arms.
Use your emergency lights.
Flash your headlights.

questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians who may not see you. If you think another driver is about to hit you, sound your horn immediately.

questions.question: You see a sign that says "Reduced speed, 35 mph." What does this mean?

options.text: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
The new 35 mph speed limit starts at the next speed limit sign.
You have plenty of time to slow down before the reduced speed zone.
You should only reduce your speed to 35 mph during bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
questions.explanation: "Reduced speed" signs tell drivers to slow down. The new speed limit begins right at the sign.

questions.question: You are under 21 and convicted of carrying a fake ID. You must pay $500 and lose your license for 90 days:

options.text: Only if your blood alcohol content (BAC) is 0.02 percent or higher.
Even if you were not driving.
Only if you were driving at the time of arrest.
Only if your BAC is 0.02 percent or higher and you were driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Even if you were not driving.
questions.explanation: If you are under 21 and convicted of carrying a fake ID, your license will be suspended even if you were not driving. The first offense includes a $500 fine, court costs, and a 90-day license suspension.

questions.question: Why is it important to leave space between your vehicle and others?

options.text: It prevents distractions from other vehicles.
It gives you time to react to unexpected situations.
It keeps traffic moving at a safe speed.
It keeps other drivers alert.

questions.correctAnswerText: It gives you time to react to unexpected situations.
questions.explanation: Leave plenty of space between your vehicle and others. This gives you enough time to react if another driver makes a mistake.

questions.question: A car is coming toward you with high beams on. Where should you look?

options.text: Either side of the road
The center of the road
The right side of the road
The left side of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: The right side of the road
questions.explanation: If an oncoming car has high beams on and does not dim them, look toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded and helps you stay on course until the car passes.

questions.question: When can you drive carefully through a yellow light?

options.text: When an emergency vehicle is crossing your lane.
When pedestrians are crossing.
When you are turning right.
When you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, you may continue carefully through it.

questions.question: When you enter a street from a driveway, you must:

options.text: Drive slowly to let approaching vehicles and pedestrians move out of your way.
Honk your horn so approaching vehicles and pedestrians know to give you room.
Stop and proceed only when there are no pedestrians or vehicles approaching.
Ignore pedestrians if there is no sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and proceed only when there are no pedestrians or vehicles approaching.
questions.explanation: Always stop before entering the roadway from a driveway. Yield to any approaching vehicles or pedestrians crossing. Stop before crossing the sidewalk. Failure to stop is against the law.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle if the line between your lane and the lane you want to enter is a ____ line.

options.text: Broken white
Double solid yellow
Solid yellow
Solid white

questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. You may cross broken white lines to pass if the passing lane is clear.
